directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Main-unit weight is is 4200 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机写成：外形尺寸是4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。理论输送量是25 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map)。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map). Subject: Maßstabsleiste. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. The frame “Excavator” shows Liebherr 314 wheeled excavator and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map)。画面主体：Maßstabsleiste。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机写成：外形尺寸是4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 4200 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Subject: Liebherr 314 wheeled excavator. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是25 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。主体：Liebherr 314 轮式挖掘机。

heading.zh: 忽略曲率的大比例地图

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 4200 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m.
body.zh: 画面「Excavator」的主体是Liebherr 314 轮式挖掘机，不是这个型号的工地实测。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 25 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 4200 kg.

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map).
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map)画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 25 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_(map).
